verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say every review comment carries suggested code and a one-click 'Fix with your Agent' button. That button hands the issue, with file paths, line numbers and the suggested fix, to an external coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Devin to apply. This is Greptile's own suggested-fix-plus-one-click flow, but it is not a natively committable diff: applying the change depends on a third-party agent rather than a commit straight from the PR comment. missing for 10: evidence that comments include native committable suggestion blocks applied directly in the PR, one-click commit without an external agent, hands-on or independent corroboration.
